title: The cosmology of long range Yukawa interactions in general backgrounds
summary: Long-range forces in the early universe may lead to early structure formation and, perhaps, to primordial black holes. We generalise previous studies of fermions coupled to a light scalar field by considering general scalar-field-dependent couplings in cosmological backgrounds with a constant equation of state. We identify two broad regimes: a scaling regime, in which the scalar field oscillates around a point of vanishing fermion mass, and an asymptotic regime, in which the field evolves toward configurations where the fermions recover their bare mass.
